title: RenderingGen Job V1
description: Envelope contract for a RenderingGen render job. One job corresponds to one video SEGMENT (never a single overlay): the render_plan contains every element of the segment — base video, background, phrases, keywords, images and animations — as the semantic renderinggen.overlay-plan.v1 document, which RenderingGen compiles exclusively into chronon.render-plan.v2 before execution. A concrete chronon render plan is NOT a valid render_plan on this boundary.

id.description: Job identifier, e.g. video-983 (one per segment).

schema.description: Envelope schema name, following the same schema+version convention as the Chronon3d render-plan schema.

render_plan.description: The semantic renderinggen.overlay-plan.v1 emitted by PipelineGen. It is the ONLY accepted render_plan; RenderingGen compiles it exclusively to chronon.render-plan.v2. A concrete Chronon plan is rejected fail-closed (see CONFORMANCE.md).

assets.description: Assets referenced by the render_plan, addressed by content hash and the logical path they must be materialized at inside the job workspace.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the asset bytes in the artifact store (used for L1/L2/L3 resolution).

logical_path.description: Path relative to the job assets root where the asset must be materialized, e.g. videos/base.mp4 or images/apple.png. This is the path the render_plan layer sources/asset fields refer to.

source_url.description: Optional durable HTTP(S) location used by RenderingGen to self-heal a cache miss. It is never used as the workspace logical path.
